I lost the game. Final score: Red (me) 28, Blue 40, a difference of −12.

Strategy: In rounds 1 to 6 I estimated what the remaining cards were worth and solved each round's Hold/Steal/Trap choice as a small matrix game. That led me to play my highest number in each of those rounds, which may have been wrong, since Blue kept saving its extreme numbers instead. From round 7 on, I worked out the rest of the game exactly by working backwards from the last round and chose from the resulting best mixes. I was up 28–24 before round 9, which was a genuine guess: my exact solution put about 55% on Blue holding there. Blue trapped my Steal, then scored its 10 with Hold in the last round, which swung the result from +4 to −12.

Other commands or tools used: none
